Velení polských bezpečnostních sil vyslalo do Podlaského a Varmijsko-mazurského vojvodství posily, včetně příslušníků polské speciální jednotky GROM, dalších příslušníků pohraniční stráže a policejních protiteroristických jednotek.
Podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska se posily aktivovaly, když pohraničníci v noci na úterý zaznamenali…

Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten was to hold crisis talks with key partners Friday in a last-ditch bid to save his minority coalition government from collapse only nine months after taking power.
An unseemly political row over tax policy has raised the spectre of snap elections in the European Union's fifth-largest economy and weakened the centrist Jetten, the country's youngest-ever prime minister.
Since winning a razor-thin election, Jetten's D66 party has been in an uneasy three-way coalition with the centre-right CDA and the right-wing VVD.
After months of complex debate over tax policy, the D66 and CDA struck a deal with the opposition left-wing PRO party, enraging the VVD.
VVD leader Dilan Yesilgoz, also defence minister, lashed out, saying the coalition would require a "fundamental reset" if her partners sided with the opposition.

Menu

ENGLISH
Editorial Team

13 November 2026 at 06:00
3 min read
ROME – The intelligence services had warned days earlier that, after aircraft, schools could be the next targets. Politicians have been debating the issue for years. Twelve months ago, Defence Minister Guido Crosetto unveiled a plan setting out the structures, powers and tools needed to respond.
A country caught unprepared
(lapresse)
Yet when an email threatening bombings and massacres reached 6,000 schools across the country, Italy was caught off guard. Not when it came to the investigation, but in its handling of the emergency.
In the same family, one child may have been evacuated while another was left in the classroom. The same threat, two different responses. And one question: who decides what action should be taken?
Proof of the country's lack of preparedness came the following day, when the authorities scrambled to put things right: new threat emails were ignored, and work began on drawing up a protocol for managing this type of risk. It was a response that should have come…

Tak uvidíme, nakolik jsme odolní.
Dále se ale v dnešním newsletteru Tohle je Evropa dočtete:
Demonstruje se ve Španělsku i Polsku.
V Abú Dhabí se jedná o Ukrajině i Evropě, ale tak trochu bez ní.
Ruský plyn do Evropy stále teče, ale je ho méně a méně.
Bobři se vracejí do jezera Loch Ness, zatímco jezevčíci oslňují svou krásou.
Vyhodíme vaši školu do povětří a za ministrovu hlavu zaplatíme!

shrnuti: In Italien sind erneut Bombendrohungen an Schulen gesendet worden. Es sollen etwa 1.600 Einrichtungen betroffen sein. Die Regierung will Gebäude künftig nur noch räumen lassen, wenn konkrete Hinweise auf eine Gefahr vorliegen.

Erneut Bombendrohungen gegen Schulen in Italien
Stand: 12.11.2026 • 15:25 Uhr
In Italien sind erneut Bombendrohungen an Schulen gesendet worden. Es sollen etwa 1.600 Einrichtungen betroffen sein. Die Regierung will Gebäude künftig nur noch räumen lassen, wenn konkrete Hinweise auf eine Gefahr vorliegen.
Hunderte Schulen in Italien haben erneut Bombendrohungen per E-Mail erhalten. Einige Bildungseinrichtungen wurden Medienberichten zufolge evakuiert. Die Regierung von Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni hat jedoch nach eigenen Angaben über die zuständigen Ministerien die lokalen Behörden und jeweiligen Schulleitungen darüber informiert, dass der Schulbetrieb regulär fortgesetzt werden soll.
Bereits am Mittwoch hatten etwa 6.000 Schulen solche Droh-E-Mails erhalten. Heute gingen nach Angaben der Nachrichtenagentur Ansa bei etwa 1.800 Einrichtungen Drohungen ein. Auffällige Funde gab es in den betroffenen Schulen aber nicht.

Igen i dag er skoler over hele Italien blevet evakueret efter at have modtaget mails med bombetrusler. Billedet her er fra Venedig i går, hvor mange italienske skoler lukkede af samme årsag. (Foto: © Andrea Merola, EPA/Ritzau Scanpix)

Af

En række italienske skoler er igen i dag blevet evakueret efter at have modtaget mails med bombetrusler.
Det skriver det italienske nyhedsbureau Ansa.
Den italienske regering har netop meddelt, at omkring 1.800 italienske skoler i dag har modtaget bombetrusler. 
Truslerne er sendt til skoler over hele landet - blandt andet til skoler i regionerne Ligurien, Umbrien og i hovedstaden Rom.
Det er anden dag i streg, at italienske skoler modtager bombetrusler. 
I går modtog skoler i Irland, Nordirland og Skotland også bombetrusler. I alle tre lande opfattede politiets mailsene som fupnumre, men valgte alligevel at evakuere en del skoler.

Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg
November 12, 2026, 7:55 am
Source: Fontanka
A car exploded in St. Petersburg’s Shushary district, killing a Russian colonel who was behind the wheel. The blast occurred on Kolpinskoye Highway.
The explosive device had been attached to the underside of the car and detonated as the colonel was pulling out of a courtyard, according to the St. Petersburg-based news outlet Fontanka. The serviceman died.
Traffic on Kolpinskoye Highway near the blast site has been shut down.
A car carrying a lieutenant colonel and his wife exploded on Kolpinskoye Highway on August 27. The serviceman died. His wife survived. An explosive device had been attached to the underside of the car. Fontanka, a St. Petersburg-based news outlet, citing sources, reported that a 24-year-old Russian woman who left for Turkey after the blast is suspected of planting the bomb in the car. Law enforcement agencies have not officially commented on the progress of the investigation.

An Tausenden Schulen in Italien sind per E-Mail Bombendrohungen eingegangen. Auch in Großbritannien gibt es ähnliche Fälle. Die Behörden gehen von Falschmeldungen aus. Wer hinter den Drohungen steckt, ist unklar.
Etwa 6.000 Schulen in Italien haben E-Mails mit Bombendrohungen erhalten. Die Regierung gab inzwischen Entwarnung: Italiens Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni betonte, nach den bisher durchgeführten Überprüfungen gebe es keinerlei Hinweise auf eine konkrete Gefahr. Vorsorglich waren nach Regierungsangaben dennoch mindestens 300 Schulen evakuiert worden.
Von den Behörden gab es zunächst keine Angaben zu möglichen Hintergründen der Bombendrohungen. Meloni schrieb auf Facebook von einer "Strategie, die darauf abzielt, Beunruhigung und Sorge zu schüren". Sie kündigte eine umfassende Untersuchung der Vorfälle an und berief eine Krisensitzung der Regierung ein.

Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day.

Russian pro-war military bloggers report pilots killed during Ukrainian drone attack on Leningrad region
November 11, 2026, 12:45 pm

Russian Telegram channels covering military aviation reported that pilots were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Leningrad region.
The news appeared on the Fighterbomber channel, run by Z-blogger Ilya Tumanov. “Today’s defense of the skies over St. Petersburg from the drone attack cost us very dearly. Very, very dearly,” he wrote, without giving any details.
The Telegram channel Na predele “On the Edge” also reported the pilots’ deaths without specifying the circumstances. The post included a photo of a Ka-52 “Alligator” helicopter.
Russian authorities have officially said only that a Ukrainian drone attack on Ust-Luga, in the Kingisepp district, injured three port workers.

Eine anonyme Bombendrohung hat heute an rund 300 Schulen in Italien Alarm ausgelöst. Betroffen waren Bildungseinrichtungen in mehreren Städten. Schüler und Schulpersonal wurden vorsorglich evakuiert. Polizeikräfte durchsuchten die Gebäude nach möglichen Sprengsätzen.
Besonders viele Schulen waren in Rom betroffen. Die Schulleitungen verständigten die Polizei, die zur Räumung der Gebäude riet. Der Absender der Droh-E-Mails gab sich Medienberichten zufolge als Vertreter einer terroristischen Organisation aus.
Krisensitzung einberufen
Die italienische Regierung reagierte mit einer kurzfristig einberufenen Krisensitzung unter der Leitung von Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni. Der italienische Verteidigungsminister Guido Crosetto verurteilte die Bombendrohungen. Sie seien Teil einer „Strategie, Angst und Besorgnis zu verbreiten“.
Die Sicherheitskräfte seien gerade damit beschäftigt, ernst zu nehmende Drohungen von den Taten profilierungssüchtiger Menschen zu unterscheiden, sagte der Minister. Solche Fälle würden leider…

November 11, 2026, 9:22 am
Source: Meduza
Russia’s FSB arrested two Polish citizens in the Kaliningrad region on espionage charges, its Public Relations Center said.
A Polish intelligence “network of agents” had been operating in the region, the FSB said.
It said they collected and passed on information about Russian military personnel and Defense Ministry facilities, as well as “information about the socio-economic situation, and migration and social policy” in the region.
The FSB also issued official warnings against espionage and treason to seven more Polish citizens and three Russian citizens who had contact with Polish intelligence services. The seven Poles were barred from entering Russia “for an extended period.”
The FSB made the announcement on Poland’s Independence Day, which falls on November 11.

Ukrainian drones strike port in Russia’s Leningrad region, sparking fire
November 11, 2026, 8:13 am
Source: Alexander Drozdenko
Ukrainian drones attacked Russia’s Leningrad region overnight on November 11, and 150 of them were shot down over the region, Governor Alexander Drozdenko said.
He said the attack targeted the port zone of Ust-Luga, in the Kingisepp district. Several drones hit the area, sparking a fire and injuring three port workers. A transformer substation in Ust-Luga also experienced an emergency shutdown.
The drone attack forced the closure of Pulkovo Airport. Passenger planes flying to St. Petersburg from Istanbul and Hurghada landed in Helsinki instead. By morning, 30 outbound flights from Pulkovo were delayed .
Smolensk region also came under drone attack, and air defenses shot down 37 drones, said the region’s governor, Vasily Anokhin. In the city of Yartsevo, “debris” hit a multi-story building, sparking a fire. Two people died.
Videos posted online show an apartment on fire inside a residential building.

FBI Director Kash Patel called the arrest “important” and said it “involves allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies.”
Noting the investigation is ongoing, he added that the FBI “has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners.”

November 10, 2026, 5:09 pm
Source: Internal Security Agency of Poland (ABW)
Two Ukrainian citizens, ages 24 and 25, have been arrested in Poland on suspicion of espionage and sabotage on behalf of Russian intelligence services, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the Polish minister who coordinates the country’s intelligence services.
Investigators allege that the two photographed critical infrastructure and military facilities in Poland and set cars on fire. They replaced vehicle license plates with plates from Ukrainian military vehicles to deflect suspicion. They were paid for these tasks, including in cryptocurrency.
Poland’s Internal Security Agency said both suspects have been ordered held in custody for three months. They face sentences ranging from 10 years to life in prison, the agency said.

A freight train derailed in northwestern Russia’s Arkhangelsk region following the collapse of a railroad bridge, Russian Railways and local officials said Tuesday, causing disruptions to passenger rail service along the affected track.
Arkhangelsk region Governor Alexander Tsybulsky said the accident took place around 5:10 a.m. Moscow time. He said part of a railroad bridge over the Viled River collapsed, leading several freight cars to derail.
Tsybulsky said officials were coordinating an emergency response effort. No one was injured in the accident.
At least eight long-distance passenger trains traveling between major cities — including Moscow and St. Petersburg — were left stranded following the derailment.

titulek: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
titulekPuvodni: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
shrnuti: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.

vyrez.text:
French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104 - BBC News
Image source, Site Pôle Jean Moulin
Image caption, Solange Alexandre twice turned down the Légion d'Honneur before relenting in 2024
By Hugh Schofield in Paris
Published
38 minutes ago
One of France's last Resistance heroes from World War Two has died at the age of 104. Solange Alexandre was also a rare woman who, with her future husband, created and commanded her own unit of anti-German fighters.
After serving as a Resistance courier from 1941, three years later she founded the Pas-de-Boeuf network near the town of Ruillé-sur-Loir.
With some 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and, after the Allied landings in Normandy on D-Day in 1944, joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
President Emmanuel Macron was among many to pay tribute to Alexandre, after her death was announced at a nursing home in Le Mans.
"She said she only ever did her duty. But her duty was our freedom. France will never forget. Thank you," Macron posted on social media.
